replies.author: Likoluc
replies.body: I always loved your ign and since the moment I joined avicus I really wanted to meet you, because you were a really nice and cool guy on the forums and also on ts when we talked a few weeks ago. I never got to play many scrims with you, but I can say that you are decent with sword and bow and a damn smart player in game

replies.author: Likoluc
replies.body:
I feel that you want one so here I go
Stim you're an amazing leader, you can always organize nocturne well before a scrimm and keep communication up during it, and thats the reason we beat a lot of experienced team even though we're somewhat new. We became kind of friends on the time i've been on nocturne, and Imo you're a really nice guy that can make jokes and also meme other people without offend anyone. Like you dont do things such as like dark humour or jokes to make people feel bad, and I really like it on you. Finally, as a player, you're good at sword and decent at bow, great leader and shotcaller and a really intelligent player!
